cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(ExampleTransport LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(NETCODE_TRANSPORT_INCLUDE "" CACHE PATH "Installed Netcode transport SDK include directory")
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT EXISTS "${NETCODE_TRANSPORT_INCLUDE}/netcode/transport_provider.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This sample requires Windows and the installed Netcode transport C header.")
endif()
add_library(example_pipe MODULE pipe.cpp)
target_include_directories(example_pipe PRIVATE "${NETCODE_TRANSPORT_INCLUDE}")
target_compile_features(example_pipe PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(example_pipe PRIVATE NC_TRANSPORT_BUILD_DLL)
install(TARGETS example_pipe RUNTIME DESTINATION bin LIBRARY DESTINATION bin)
add_library(example_wrong_abi MODULE wrong_abi.c)
target_include_directories(example_wrong_abi PRIVATE "${NETCODE_TRANSPORT_INCLUDE}")
target_compile_definitions(example_wrong_abi PRIVATE NC_TRANSPORT_BUILD_DLL)
install(TARGETS example_wrong_abi RUNTIME DESTINATION bin LIBRARY DESTINATION bin)
